name: spell-epic
description: spell-epic:  the epic tooling -- epic pages, the epic command, worktrees and windows, the review loop -- as a Claude Code plugin, loaded in place

scripts.test:node: yarn workspace @spell-app/epics vp test run --project node
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @spell-app/epics lint && vp lint --max-warnings 0 vscode/src tests/vscode
scripts.format: yarn workspace @spell-app/epics format && vp fmt vscode/src vscode/build.mjs tests/vscode
scripts.review:
yarn ts && yarn lint && yarn test && echo '== REVIEW PASSED
===========
'
